inputs.description: The operator uses the Tailscale OAuth client with this ID. The client needs write scope for Services, Devices Core and Auth Keys, and the tag tag:k8s-operator. The tailnet policy must make tag:k8s-operator an owner of tag:k8s, the proxies' default tag.
inputs.name: oauthClientId

inputs.description: The operator authenticates with this OAuth client secret.
inputs.name: oauthClientSecret

zh-CN.summary: 把服务放到你的 tailnet 上，提供受信任的 HTTPS，无需对互联网开放端口。

zh-TW.summary: 把服務放上你的 tailnet，提供受信任的 HTTPS，不必對網際網路開放連接埠。

metadata.name: Tailscale Kubernetes operator
metadata.summary: Puts services on your tailnet with trusted HTTPS and no port open to the internet.

releases.name: tailscale-operator
releases.values:
oauth:
  # Empty, so the chart renders no Secret; the operator mounts
  # operator-oauth, created from the inputs before install.
  clientId: ""
  clientSecret: ""
operatorConfig:
  image:
    # Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move. Always pulls on every restart.
    repository: tailscale/k8s-operator
    tag: v1.104.4@sha256:68fc0aa4e1c3d7ba19ca41c0bc27f17b2a5a8dca6c10efcdd18020a6bf97768d
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
proxyConfig:
  # The proxies the operator creates, pinned by digest.
  image:
    repository: tailscale/tailscale
    tag: v1.104.4@sha256:ed6480b33c6eb67c9cbd203ed42b9fb57e361986725b6856def71b7a3d9e276c
apiServerProxyConfig:
  # No Kubernetes API proxy and no impersonation ClusterRole.
  mode: "false"
  allowImpersonation: "false"

security.summary: Creates, updates and deletes Services and Ingresses (and their status) in every namespace; reads nodes and EndpointSlices; manages ValidatingAdmissionPolicies and their bindings. In its own namespace it manages Secrets, ConfigMaps, ServiceAccounts, StatefulSets, Deployments, Roles and RoleBindings. Installs eight CRDs (connectors, dnsconfigs, peerrelays, proxyclasses, proxygrouppolicies, proxygroups, recorders, tailnets) and the IngressClass tailscale.
